changes.title: Trump claims Iran talks will start Monday, and 4 other developments in the Middle East
changes.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said new talks to wind down the war in Iran will start Monday, after announcing he is holding off on new massive strikes he had threatened to unleash on the country.

changes.title: Oil prices fall more than 5% as Middle East tensions ebb on diplomatic efforts
changes.summary: Oil prices fell on Monday as investors pared geopolitical risk premiums after U.S. President Donald Trump said he had called off a planned strike on Iran.

changes.title: Trump Calls for Pause on Military Strikes Against Iran
changes.summary: President Donald Trump has called for a pause on military strikes against Iran after he says Iran and other countries in the Middle East asking him to “hold off.” The president said that he agreed to cancel attacks “subject to being able to rapidly make a DEAL.” NBC’s Julie Tsirkin reports for Sunday TODAY.

changes.title: State Department urges Americans to consider leaving Middle East as regional conflict escalates
changes.summary: The State Department on Saturday urged Americans across the Middle East to consider leaving the region or be prepared to depart on short notice, warning of flight disruptions and security risks as the conflict with Iran escalates.

changes.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia as Middle East war widens
changes.summary: Yemeni rebels accuse Saudis of ‘dangerous escalation’ as tit-for-tat strikes mark new front in war that has engulfed region Iran-backed Houthi rebels vowed to retaliate against Saudi Arabia on Saturday after they accused the kingdom of targeting civilian infrastructure, as the Middle East war widens across the region.

changes.title: Concerns over U.S. weapons getting depleted as U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes
changes.summary: As the U.S. builds up forces in the Middle East amid the ongoing war with Iran, there's concern among some officials that U.S. weapons may be getting depleted. It comes as President Trump has threatened new escalations and as the U.S. and Iran continue to trade strikes. Charlie D'Agata reports.
